facts.name: Darren Steele
facts.assignment: Martin County: one-third of County Court cases; County Election Canvassing Board (profile).

contact.contact_note: No fax or courtroom published in reviewed profile/roster.

chambers_communications.summary: Provide case number and party names when contacting assistant; copy all parties and file material sent to judge.

hearing_scheduling.summary: All hearings through assistant; no online calendar. Send hearing notice to all parties, clerk and judicial office at least five business days ahead; mailing five days before is insufficient. Notify assistant and file/serve cancellations promptly. Profile calendar paragraph separately instructs that motions must be mailed directly to assistant; preserve that route distinct from email permission for orders/courtesy materials.

proposed_orders.summary: PDF/a or Word by assistant email or mailed hardcopy; supply evidence of opposing-party agreement when agreement asserted and all service emails.

courtesy_copies.summary: For evidentiary proceedings send courtesy legal materials in PDF or Word by assistant email, mail or delivery with reasonable review time. Do not send trial evidence to judge in advance.

remote_appearances.summary: Written motion with sufficient review time required. Zoom details from assistant; evidentiary hearings in person; remote appearances at end of docket.

facts.summary: Contacts and practical county-civil scheduling, submission and appearance instructions reviewed; noncivil mechanics excluded.
gaps: Fax and courtroom not published in reviewed profile/roster.

review_scope.collected: Complete official profile HTML, text and link inventory.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Contacts, assignment and recurring civil operating instructions.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Detailed criminal procedures, biography, forms and calendars; printable procedures link only. Template-example passages not asserted as operative requirements.
